root.message: What is the issue with your reward?

options.label: My redemption is pending for too long
My PayPal payment did not arrive

pending_long.message: Reward processing normally takes 3-5 business days. For charity and PayPal transfers, it can be up to 10 days. If your redemption has been pending for longer, raise a ticket.

wrong_reward.message: If you received the wrong reward, please raise a ticket immediately and we will correct it. Please include your redemption reference number.

paypal_missing.message: PayPal transfers can take 3-5 business days after we process the payout. Check that your PayPal account email matches what you registered. If it has been more than 7 days, raise a ticket.
